customers.evidence: Our clients’ interests always come first.

employees.evidence: Our people are our greatest asset – we say it often and with good reason.

dei.evidence: Our commitment to creating and sustaining a diverse work environment is absolute.

community.evidence: help them contribute positively to their greater communities.

shareholders.evidence: Our goal is to provide superior returns to our shareholders.

integrity.evidence: Integrity and honesty are at the heart of our business.

innovation.evidence: We stress creativity and imagination in everything we do.

result.analyst_notes: Institutional, first-person plural voice with largely absolute wording ('absolute', 'always come first'). Clients and people are addressed first, shareholders and integrity follow. Progress claims are hedged ('some progress', 'significant work to do'). Principles are framed aspirationally, with the business principles section stating values in short declarative sentences.
